title: 相思
author: 王维
intro: Red beans grow in the south, and the Chinese call them “longing seeds”. The poet asks a friend to pick plenty of them — because nothing holds longing better.
analysis: 红豆是南方的一种植物，种子鲜红，传说古代一位女子在树下思念远方的丈夫，哭死在树下，化成了红豆，所以红豆又叫“相思子”。诗人先说红豆长在南方，再轻轻问一句：春天来了，它又长出几枝了？问的是红豆，其实是在想远方的人。第三句劝朋友：多摘一些吧；最后一句说出原因：这东西最能代表思念。全诗没有一个字直接说“我想你”，而是把感情放在一个小小的红豆上，这叫“托物寄情”——借一个东西来表达感情。正因为说得含蓄，所以读起来更深情。后来“红豆”成了中国人表达思念和爱情的固定意象，今天的歌曲里也常唱到。
analysisEn: Red beans (hóngdòu) grow in southern China. Their seeds are a brilliant red, and a legend says a woman who wept to death under a tree while longing for her absent husband turned into these seeds — so they are also called “longing seeds”. The poem starts with a fact: red beans grow in the south. Then it asks, lightly, how many new branches have grown this spring? The question is about the plant, but the poet is really thinking of someone far away. The third line urges the friend: pick lots of them. The last line explains why: nothing stands for longing better. The poem never says “I miss you”. Instead it puts all the feeling into one small red seed — a technique called tuō wù jì qíng, “entrusting feelings to an object”. Because the feeling is held back, it feels deeper. Ever since, the red bean has been the classic Chinese image of longing and love, and it still appears in pop songs today.
background: Wang Wei (701?–761) was a poet, painter and musician, famous for quiet landscape poems. This poem is traditionally said to have been sent to a friend, the musician Li Guinian; it was a popular song in the Tang dynasty.
pronunciation: 撷 xié（摘取）；发 fā（长出）。按网站规则不变调。
version: 采用通行的教材版本。重要异文：“春来发几枝”一作“秋来发故枝”；“愿君多采撷”一作“劝君休采撷”（“休”是“别摘”，意思正好相反——怕你摘了更想念）。网站用通行本“愿君多采撷”。题目一作《相思》，一作《江上赠李龟年》。

lines.lit: Red beans grow in the southern land;
lines.en: Red beans grow in the south —

lines.lit: spring comes — how many branches have sprouted?
lines.en: how many new sprigs this spring?

lines.lit: I hope you will pick many;
this thing is most full of longing.

words.en: red bean (seed of the coral-pea tree)
words.note: 诗里的红豆是“相思子”，不是做红豆沙的赤豆。
书面语，现代汉语说“南方”。
现代汉语“树枝”，也是量词“一枝花”。
古代对人的尊称；现代汉语一般不这样用。
书面语，现代汉语说“采”“摘”。
此：这；物：东西。现代汉语说“这个东西”。
现代汉语仍用，如“单相思”“相思病”。

imagery.name: 红豆
imagery.zh: 红豆是思念的化身：摘下红豆，就像把思念收在手里、寄给对方。
imagery.en: The red bean is longing in solid form: picking it is like holding your love and sending it on.

imagery.name: 春
imagery.zh: 春天是红豆发新枝的季节，也是思念悄悄生长的时候。
imagery.en: Spring is when the red-bean tree puts out new branches — and when longing quietly grows too.
